mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 5 Series 545i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 545i engine replacement typically costs £2,200-£3,500 for a rebuilt unit supply-only, with used options from £1,000 and reconditioned from £1,800. Labour for supply and fit adds approximately £1,000-£1,500 (15-20 hours at independent specialist rates) due to the V8's complexity. Dealer pricing is significantly higher.

mainEntity.name: Does the BMW 545i have timing chain problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlike the later N47 and N57 diesel engines, the N62B44 V8 uses two timing chains rather than one, and does not suffer from the same catastrophic guide failure. However, the N62's primary weaknesses are valve stem seal wear, VANOS and Valvetronic system faults, and oil leaks from various seals.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 545i?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the car's condition and value. A typical 545i (2003-2005) is worth £3,000-£8,000. For a well-maintained, low-mileage example worth £6,000+, a £2,200-£3,500 replacement is a viable investment. For a car worth under £4,000, a full replacement may approach or exceed the vehicle's value - in which case a used engine or scrap may be better options.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the 545i and 550i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 545i and 550i are both V8-powered 5 Series models, but they use different engines. The 545i (2003-2005) uses the N62B44 4.4-litre V8 producing 325-333hp. The 550i (2005-2010) uses the larger N62B48 4.8-litre V8 producing 367hp. The 550i replaced the 545i in the E60 range from September 2005.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 545i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical BMW 545i engine replacement takes 3-5 working days for supply and fit through an independent specialist. The V8 engine is more complex to remove and install than a four- or six-cylinder unit, adding to the labour time. Allow additional time for parts sourcing and any ancillary work.

mainEntity.name: What warranty comes with a BMW 545i replacement engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every rebuilt and reconditioned BMW 545i engine supplied through EnginesMarket carries a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Terms vary by supplier - some offer extended coverage up to 24 months on premium rebuilds. Used engines typically come with a shorter warranty (30-90 days) depending on the supplier and mileage.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 5 Series 545i - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 545i was the flagship petrol V8 of the E60 5 Series range, sitting above the 530i and below the M5. Produced from 2003 to 2005, it featured BMW's N62B44 4.4-litre V8 - a sophisticated engine with double VANOS and Valvetronic technology.

milestones.description: September 2005 - Production ends; replaced by the 550i with the N62B48 4.8L V8

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the BMW 5 Series 545i is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: BMW 5 Series 545i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 545i's N62B44 V8 is a refined and powerful engine, but it has several well-documented weak points as mileage accumulates. The most common issues are oil leaks, valve stem seal wear, and Valvetronic/VANOS system faults. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Oil Consumption - Valve Stem Seal Wear in the BMW 545i N62B44
problems.rootCause: The N62B44 is known for excessive oil consumption due to worn valve stem seals. This allows oil to seep past the seals and into the combustion chamber, causing blue smoke from the exhaust, particularly on start-up or after idling.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace all valve stem seals - engine-out job on V8
repairOptions.longevity: Best if caught early with smoking symptoms
Best if oil consumption has caused other damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical used BMW 545i (2003-2005) sits in the £3,000-£8,000 bracket. For a car worth under £4,000, a full engine replacement may approach or exceed the vehicle's value - evaluate scrap value carefully. For well-maintained, low-mileage examples worth £6,000+, replacement is usually justified.
problems.recommendation: If your 545i is smoking on start-up, get the valve stem seals inspected immediately. A £1,500-£2,500 specialist repair is far cheaper than a £3,000+ full engine replacement if the issue is ignored and causes further damage.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt N62B44 BMW 5 Series 545i engine prices

problems.h4: Valvetronic and VANOS System Faults - BMW 545i N62B44
problems.rootCause: The N62B44's Valvetronic and double VANOS systems are complex and can develop faults. Symptoms include rough idling, poor throttle response, reduced power, and occasionally the engine failing to start.
problems.vehicleValueCheck: Valvetronic and VANOS repairs are a manageable percentage of most 545i values. For a car worth £4,000+, a £400-£800 repair is a sensible investment.
problems.recommendation: Don't ignore rough running or poor throttle response. A £400-£800 specialist repair is far cheaper than the cost of a full engine replacement if the issue is left to escalate.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 5 Series 545i engine repair costs

problems.h4: Oil Leaks - Common Seepage Points on the BMW 545i N62B44
problems.rootCause: The N62B44 is prone to oil leaks from the generator housing seal and crankshaft oil seal. These leaks can be difficult to diagnose and expensive to repair due to the engine's V8 layout.

repairOptions.longevity: Only if oil loss has caused other damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Oil leak repairs are a small fraction of any 545i's value and should be addressed promptly. Ignoring a £300-£600 repair can lead to more serious engine damage.
problems.recommendation: Address oil leaks early. A £300-£600 specialist repair is far cheaper than the consequences of oil starvation. Regularly check oil levels and look for visible leaks under the car.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 5 Series 545i engine replacement prices
